title: Try
description: Try a list of wrangles and catch any errors that occur.

recipe_writer.reason: Error-control orchestration is not supported in the baseline.

parameters.name: retries
parameters.description: Number of times to retry the wrangles if an error occurs. Default 0.

parameters.name: except
parameters.description: An action to take if the wrangles encounter an error. This can contain a list of wrangles or a dictionary of column names and values. If except is not provided, the error will be logged and the recipe will continue.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Run a list of wrangles and catch errors. When `except` is provided, its wrangles or fallback column values run after an error; otherwise, the error is logged and the recipe continues. ## Migrated examples #### Use Fallback Wrangles After an Error ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - try: wrangles: - risky_wrangle: input: column except: - backup_wrangle: input: column ```
##### Input Sample _The input dataframe is passed to the primary wrangles._
##### Output Sample _The primary result is returned on success; the `except` result is returned after an error._
